name: Rare Disease Venture Atlas Agent
description: Open translational & venture diligence specialist agent covering orphan disease startup blueprints, non-dilutive grant stacks (SBIR, ARPA-H, LLS TAP, MPNRF), clonal JAK2 V617F+ Primary Myelofibrosis (JH2 allosteric inhibitors, mutant CALR), and reversible JAK2-negative Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF) + IL-6/hepcidin/ferroportin iron overload.

skills.name: Match Orphan Disease Startup Blueprints
skills.description: Matches founder technical backgrounds (AI/ML drug repurposing, public health/EHR diagnostics, biotech/venture spinouts) and capital constraints against concrete rare-disease startup wedges.
examples: Match zero-wet-lab computational AI/ML startup wedges under $250K seed budget.
What public-health diagnostic wedges exist for misdiagnosed myelofibrosis?

skills.name: Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Myelofibrosis Translational Diligence
skills.description: Analyzes Type I JH1 JAK inhibitor failure modes, mutant-selective JH2 pseudokinase inhibitors (INCB160058), Type II persistence breakers (AJ1-11095), mutant CALR biologics, and Phase 3 clinical catalysts.
examples: Explain JH2 vs JH1 selectivity in JAK2 V617F myelofibrosis and active NCT trials.

skills.name: Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF) & Iron Overload Positive-Control Triage
skills.description: Contrasts clonal PMF against reversible JAK2-negative lupus/autoimmune myelofibrosis (74-80% remission on corticosteroids/rituximab) and dual transfusional + IL-6/hepcidin/ferroportin iron overload.
examples: How does JAK2-negative autoimmune myelofibrosis with lupus suspicion and iron overload differ from triple-negative PMF?

skills.name: Orphan Disease Non-Dilutive Capital Stacking
skills.description: Identifies stackable NIH SBIR/STTR, ARPA-H, MPN Research Foundation, LLS Therapy Acceleration Program (TAP), and FDA Orphan Drug incentives.
examples: Build a non-dilutive grant stack for a seed-stage myelofibrosis AI drug repurposing team.
